name: list-my-issues
description: Lists the Linear issues assigned to the connected user, most recently updated first: the open ones, or completed and canceled ones too with includeCompleted. Each issue's id, identifier (like ENG-123), title, priority, url and last update, with its state, team and project. The identifier is what linear__get-issue, linear__update-issue and linear__comment-on-issue take.

first.description: Maximum number of issues to return.
